revised:
This PRD defines a unified multi-agent development system for AI-assisted software development at scale. The system combines distributed coordination, structured workflows, radical minimalism, and engineering fundamentals.

Reduces code by 53%, cost by 26%, time by 41%. Persists context across crashes. Coordinates 20-30+ agents.

flags.issue: Vague claim: 'at scale' gives no number, team size or agent count. The author must supply the scale or remove the phrase.
Forced structure: a four-item list of abstract terms with no description of what each component does. The author must name the components or describe them.
Metrics 53%, 26% and 41% have no baseline or source (compared to what, measured how). The author must supply both.
Vague claim: 'Persists context across crashes' names no storage mechanism, scope or recovery measure. The author must supply the fact or the test that shows it.
Open-ended range '20-30+' has no stated ceiling or tested maximum. The author must supply the figure that was tested or supported.
